name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention; descriptor 'tally chars with zero at field' accurately reflects the body (sum weight per char whose runtime_char byte at field_offset is zero). No Ghidra address residue.
purpose: Generic battle-AI scoring helper: sum a per-target weight over the character indices whose runtime_char status byte at a given field offset is zero (status not yet applied).
logic_summary: total = 0; for i in 0..len-1: char_idx = char_idx_arr[i]; pChar = runtime_char_array + char_idx*RUNTIME_CHAR_SIZE; if pChar[field_offset] == 0: total += weight; return total. (Decompile shows a __CHK(0x14) stack/bounds check and encodes the byte access as pSprite_state[field_offset-2] because pSprite_state lives at runtime_char+2; equivalent to runtime_char+field_offset.)
signature: int __cdecl fd2_tally_chars_with_zero_at_field(int len, uint32 char_idx_arr, int field_offset, int weight)

params.name: len
params.semantics: Number of entries to scan in char_idx_arr (n_targets from the caller).
params.reason: Descriptive, matches loop bound usage; no address residue.

params.name: char_idx_arr
params.semantics: Address of a byte array of runtime-char indices (target buffer). Each byte indexes data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr.
params.reason: Name describes a char-index array; matches body indexing. (Decompile types it byte*; src types it as uint32 address - same semantics, type unchanged per refine rules.)

params.name: field_offset
params.semantics: Byte offset into the runtime_char struct of the status field tested for zero (e.g. spell_id+0x11 for status spells, 0x25/0x26 for summon a/b).
params.reason: Accurately names the struct byte offset used for the == 0 test; no address residue.

params.name: weight
params.semantics: Score increment added to total per matching (status-clear) character (3 for status spells, 4 for summons).
params.reason: Accurately names the per-match accumulation value; no address residue.

returns.semantics: Aggregate score: weight multiplied by the count of scanned characters whose runtime_char byte at field_offset is zero.

comment_original_issue: Original src comment was correct but terse; did not state the return value nor the AI-scoring caller context (status-effect spells 17..19, summon 0x1A/0x1B) that gives the field_offset/weight their meaning.
notes: Single caller: fd2_score_spell_candidate @ 0x15B77 (status-effect spells 17..19 -> field_offset=spell_id+0x11, weight=3; spell 0x1A -> 0x25, weight=4; spell 0x1B -> 0x26, weight=4). Ghidra plate already accurate and consistent with refined understanding, so left unchanged. Note: src declares char_idx_arr as uint32 (address) while decompile types it byte*; semantics identical, type/signature intentionally not changed per refine rules.
